title: Raffles
statementMd:
Johnny is at a carnival which has $*n*$ raffles. Raffle $*i*$ has a prize with value $*p*_{*i*}$. Each participant can put tickets in whichever raffles they choose (they may have more than one ticket in a single raffle). At the end of the carnival, one ticket is selected at random from each raffle, and the owner of the ticket wins the associated prize. A single person can win multiple prizes from different raffles.

However, county rules prevent any one participant from owning more than half the tickets in a single raffle, i.e. putting more tickets in the raffle than all the other participants combined. To help combat this (and possibly win some prizes), the organizers started by placing a single ticket in each raffle, which they will never remove.

Johnny bought $*t*$ tickets and is wondering where to place them. Currently, there are a total of $*l*_{*i*}$ tickets in the $*i*$-th raffle. He watches as other participants place tickets and modify their decisions and, at every moment in time, wants to know how much he can possibly earn. Find the maximum possible expected value of Johnny's winnings at each moment if he distributes his tickets optimally. Johnny may redistribute all of his tickets arbitrarily between each update, but he may not place more than $*t*$ tickets total or have more tickets in a single raffle than all other participants combined.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$, $*t*$, and $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *t*, *q* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of raffles, the number of tickets Johnny has, and the total number of updates, respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*p*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$) — the value of the $*i*$-th prize.

The third line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*l*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$) — the number of tickets initially in the $*i*$-th raffle.

The last $*q*$ lines contain the descriptions of the updates. Each description contains two integers $*t*_{*k*}$, $*r*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*k*} ≤ 2$, $1 ≤ *r*_{*k*} ≤ *n*$) — the type of the update and the raffle number. An update of type $1$ represents another participant adding a ticket to raffle $*r*_{*k*}$. An update of type $2$ represents another participant removing a ticket from raffle $*r*_{*k*}$.

It is guaranteed that, after each update, each raffle has at least $1$ ticket (not including Johnny's) in it.

## Output

Print $*q*$ lines, each containing a single real number — the maximum expected value of Johnny's winnings after the $*k*$-th update. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png).

## Note

In the first case, Johnny only has one ticket to distribute. The prizes are worth $4$ and $5$, and the raffles initially have $1$ and $2$ tickets, respectively. After the first update, each raffle has $2$ tickets, so Johnny has expected value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/436bcf2181eea8fe79cdb015a5567ca1b8d69652.png) of winning by placing his ticket into the second raffle. The second update adds a ticket to the second raffle, so Johnny can win ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6ed6e0db65395a75b021f54fa4289733d0399cee.png) in the first raffle. After the final update, Johnny keeps his ticket in the first raffle and wins ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/83dfd107e988fb3278df4f4561bd77ba068cc202.png).

In the second case, Johnny has more tickets than he is allowed to spend. In particular, after the first update, there are $7$, $6$, and $6$ tickets in each raffle, respectively, so Johnny can only put in $19$ tickets, winning each prize with probability ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eb946338365d9781f7d2e9ec692c26702d0ae3a7.png). Also, note that after the last two updates, Johnny must remove a ticket from the last raffle in order to stay under ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eb946338365d9781f7d2e9ec692c26702d0ae3a7.png) the tickets in the third raffle.
statementZhMd:
Johnny 来到了一个有 $*n*$ 个抽奖活动的嘉年华。第 $*i*$ 个抽奖活动的奖品价值为 $*p*_{*i*}$。每位参与者可以将彩票投入自己选择的任意抽奖活动中（同一个抽奖活动中可以投入多张彩票）。嘉年华结束时，会从每个抽奖活动中随机抽取一张彩票，彩票持有者将赢得对应的奖品。同一个人可以赢得不同抽奖活动中的多个奖品。

然而，郡里的规定不允许任何参与者在单个抽奖活动中拥有超过一半的彩票，即投入的彩票数量不能多于所有其他参与者投入的彩票总数。为了应对这一规定（并且有可能赢得一些奖品），主办方在开始时就在每个抽奖活动中放入了一张彩票，并且永远不会将其取出。

Johnny 买了 $*t*$ 张彩票，现在正在考虑应该如何放置它们。目前，第 $*i*$ 个抽奖活动中总共有 $*l*_{*i*}$ 张彩票。他观察着其他参与者放入彩票并修改决定，在每个时刻都想知道自己最多可能获得多少收益。请找出在每个时刻 Johnny 以最优方式分配彩票时，其中奖品总价值的最大期望值。Johnny 可以在每次更新之间任意重新分配自己的全部彩票，但总共不能放置超过 $*t*$ 张彩票，也不能在某个抽奖活动中放置多于所有其他参与者投入的彩票数量。

## 输入

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*, *t*, and *q*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *t*, *q* ≤ 200 000$），分别表示抽奖活动的数量、Johnny 拥有的彩票数量以及更新的总数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*p*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$），表示第 $*i*$ 个抽奖活动的奖品价值。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*l*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$），表示最初第 $*i*$ 个抽奖活动中的彩票数量。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行描述更新。每次更新包含两个整数 $*t*_{*k*}$、$*r*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*k*} ≤ 2$，$1 ≤ *r*_{*k*} ≤ *n*$），分别表示更新类型和抽奖活动编号。类型 $1$ 的更新表示另一位参与者向第 $*r*_{*k*}$ 个抽奖活动中加入一张彩票。类型 $2$ 的更新表示另一位参与者从第 $*r*_{*k*}$ 个抽奖活动中取走一张彩票。

保证每次更新后，每个抽奖活动中至少有 $1$ 张彩票（不包括 Johnny 的彩票）。

## 输出

输出 $*q*$ 行，每行包含一个实数，表示第 $*k*$ 次更新后 Johnny 中奖收益的最大期望值。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则你的答案将被视为正确。

具体来说，假设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测答案为 $*b*$。检查程序会在 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png) 时认为你的答案正确。

## 说明

在第一组数据中，Johnny 只有一张彩票可以分配。奖品价值分别为 $4$ 和 $5$，两个抽奖活动最初分别有 $1$ 张和 $2$ 张彩票。第一次更新后，每个抽奖活动都有 $2$ 张彩票，因此 Johnny 将彩票放入第二个抽奖活动时，可以获得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/436bcf2181eea8fe79cdb015a5567ca1b8d69652.png) 的中奖期望值。第二次更新向第二个抽奖活动中加入了一张彩票，因此 Johnny 可以在第一个抽奖活动中赢得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6ed6e0db65395a75b021f54fa4289733d0399cee.png)。最后一次更新后，Johnny 将彩票留在第一个抽奖活动中，并赢得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/83dfd107e988fb3278df4f4561bd77ba068cc202.png)。

在第二组数据中，Johnny 拥有的彩票数量超过了规定允许他投入的数量。特别地，第一次更新后，每个抽奖活动中分别有 $7$、$6$ 和 $6$ 张彩票，因此 Johnny 最多只能投入 $19$ 张彩票，并以 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eb946338365d9781f7d2e9ec692c26702d0ae3a7.png) 的概率赢得每个奖品。另外请注意，在最后两次更新之后，为了保持低于第三个抽奖活动中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eb946338365d9781f7d2e9ec692c26702d0ae3a7.png) 的彩票数量，Johnny 必须从最后一个抽奖活动中取走一张彩票。
